terms.comment: Our explicit working description of reproducing a software bug. efficiō, efficere, effēcī, effectum — bring about or cause. The earlier QA conversation used “reproducere vitium” and “gradūs ad vitium reproducendum.” That wording is recorded here as a prior proposal, not as an independently verified technical term; this preferred description avoids relying on that verb’s modern technical sense.

phrases.latin: Hoc mendum iterum efficere nōn possum.

sources: Lewis & Short: efficio · Lewis & Short: mendum. Dictionary links support the component words; the modern technical expressions are labelled separately.
The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
